rationales: A protocol is a set of communication rules, not the content the receiver accepts.
A message is the content sent from sender to receiver.
An address identifies a destination rather than the transmitted content.
Information is the meaning conveyed, but the expected term here is message.
A channel is a communication medium, not the network in which the other device is located.
Routing forwards data between different networks.
A path is a route taken by data, but the sentence refers to a different network.
An area is not the standard term for a routing destination.
A patent can legally protect an invention or idea when its requirements are met.
Copyright law protects original expression rather than an abstract idea.
Trade secrets protect confidential business information, not ideas generally.
Fraud is a deceptive act and does not protect an idea.
A patent protects qualifying inventions rather than encoding data.
Confidentiality is keeping information secret, not the act of encoding it.
Copyright protects original creative works, not encoded data.
Encryption encodes data so it cannot be readily understood without the key.
The terminal symbol indicates the start or end of a flowchart.
A connector links parts of a flowchart.
A process symbol represents an operation or instruction.
A diamond represents a decision.
Divide and Conquer breaks a problem into smaller tasks that can be listed and handled.
Guess is not the strategy for defining a to-do list.
Act it Out models a problem by carrying out its actions.
Prototype creates an early model or version of a solution.
10 is the base of the decimal number system.
0 is a binary digit, not the base.
1 is a binary digit, not the base.
Binary uses two digits, so its base is 2.
1024⁴ bytes is a tebibyte-sized quantity, not a petabyte.
1024⁶ bytes is larger than a petabyte.
A petabyte is 1024⁵ bytes in the binary convention used here.
1024⁷ bytes is larger than a petabyte.
HTML tags are commonly classified as paired and singular (empty) tags, making two types.
Four is not the standard number of HTML tag types in this classification.
Six is not the standard number of HTML tag types in this classification.
One is incorrect because HTML has both paired and singular tags.
The Internet is a global network of interconnected networks.
An intranet is a private network within an organization.
A Personal Area Network connects devices around an individual.
An extranet gives authorized external users access to part of an organization's network.
Softlifting is unauthorized copying or use of licensed software, often among users or computers.
Counterfeiting involves making or selling fake copies of software.
Hard disk loading is the unauthorized installation of software on computers for sale.
Online piracy involves obtaining or distributing illegal software through the Internet.
Online piracy is illegal copying or distribution, not a method of protection.
A patent can provide legal protection for a qualifying invention.
Encryption protects data by encoding it, not by legally protecting an idea.
Cipher text is encrypted data, not legal protection for an idea.

Anchor links can target another location within the same page.
Hyperlink is a general term and does not specifically identify this same-page link type.
A line break moves text to a new line rather than linking page sections.
Hypertext is text containing links, not the specific type of link described.
HTML has more than four standard heading levels.
HTML has more than five standard heading levels.

HTML has six heading levels, not one.
